notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25412694/b560b7160f1528919327a428900e3bc309c3f721.png[/img]

ABOUT THIS GAME

Reformers is a retro Role-Playing Game. There’s no guide in the game, but plenty pleasures that waiting your exploration and discovery. Painting style of the game is pseudo 3D, which follows the common designs of old games. All images in game were first created by hand-sketching, and then enhanced by computers. Everything we have done is to try our best for the revival of spirits within the old times RPGs.

In the game, you will become a REFORMER, who is going to save the world. By using your special skill, the Soul Alliance, you will beat different enemies, prevent the dark cabal’s evil, collect souls of monsters or even take them as servants. At last, don’t forget to enhance the Power of Crystals. The future of reformers is in danger, and your great rescue is on the way.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/727830/Reformers/

notes.title: 暂时关闭多人游戏公告
notes.content:
关闭多人游戏的原因：
敬爱的各位卡灵玩家，卡灵的多人模式已经推出了好几个月，包括聊天和对战功能。推出这个功能主要是为了验证联机的可能性，随后此功能被应用在了新的游戏《Reformers-变革者》中，并进行了数月的优化和修改。现在回过头来看卡灵的多人模式，BUG频出，急需回炉重造。所以我们决定暂时关闭对战功能，等彻底修复后再重新开放，谢谢各位玩家的支持与谅解，还请继续关注我们的11月即将推出的新游戏《Reformers》，祝大家游戏愉快！

下个版本即将更新的内容：
1.出牌的先后手顺序变为“随机”，而不再是之前的由玩家先手。
2.新的卡牌皮肤“Reformers”即将推出，届时请留意下方的黑色小代码。

GXM

notes.title: 《Card of spirits》v1.08 update
notes.content:
Dear players:
《Card of spirits》has updated to Ver1.08. We are happy to bring this new version to you. Now, the Online multi-Player function is available. We hope that you can have a better experience in the game.

This update includes:
Improved Online Framework.

We have opened the rounded system of Online Multi-Player and made a specific explanation about this part:

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25412694/d35baa5a7797ad9908753d010c2c11cab8b7e776.png[/img]
1. After entering the main interface, players can choose the second option---Online Multi-Player.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25412694/55f3ae847a69a1a1ebca6eedac23dac567891476.png[/img]
2. Then players can choose "create a match" to create a room.

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25412694/7f946ed50e446ad4583e9537e05917d915ae5d30.png[/img]
3. After creating a room, players can see their room number in the left part ( in match [76] , as shown in the picture). The room owner's information can be seen in the bottom right corner.

All the information above is the basic stages to play online, we will next explain the rules of online games:
1.Libraries: There are three" 1" cards, four cards for number "2" to "5" each, three "6" cards, two "7" cards, one "8" card, and three cards for "J", "Q", "K", "Z", "X" each in both players' libraries. 
2.The room owner goes first.
3.The players surrendered or disconnected are defeated.
4.Others: 
a. )After creating a room, the room's owner cannot join other games unless he exits his own room.
b. )The communication function and auto-playing function are banned through challenging. Communicating can be proceeded in the waiting hall by using F5.

That's all about Ver1.08. We will keep observing the equilibrium of the game. We hope every player can have a fair game environment and enjoy the game.

notes.title: 《Card of spirits》1.07版本修复公告
notes.content:
《Card of spirits》-卡灵于2017.5.26进行更新，版本为Ver1.07。在这次的版本里，我们做了如下修复：

1.添加了“1”牌的动画效果。
2.修复了单人模式下AI在某些情况下会打出“1”投降的BUG。
3.对单人模式下AI进行了优化，现在AI的出牌思路显得更加灵活多变。
4.引入自动出牌模式，在单人模式下可以使用自动出牌，使用方法：
[1].在自己的回合按F6开启自动出牌。
[2].在自己的回合长按F7关闭自动出牌。
[3].游戏结束后会自动重开对局。如果想取消，在重开比赛的窗口出现时长按F7。

notes.title: 《Card of spirits》1.07版本更新公告
notes.content:
《Card of spirits》-卡灵于2017.5.17进行更新，版本为Ver1.07。在这次的版本里，我们做了如下更新：

1.添加了意大利语，法语，西班牙语共三种语言支持。
2.新增了游戏帮助界面。
3.添加了多人线上模式（未开放）。
在接下来的版本更新中，我们将会侧重于线上功能的开发，敬请期待！

沉寂了一年的新作品，开发组的新游戏《Reformers》现已登陆青睐之光！届时也将会和《Card of spirits卡灵》进行联动！同时我们在知名的steamcn论坛上进行了支援活动，如果您在活动帖子的下方留言并投票，直到游戏登陆steam商城，我们将会从帖子里抽出留言的20名幸运玩家，赠送《Reformers》的激活码（在青睐之光关闭之前）。往后还会陆续推出更多好玩有趣的活动，如果您喜欢这款游戏，恳请您投上这宝贵的一票，帮助我们登陆steam商城吧（感谢）！

对于购买了《Card of spirits卡灵》的玩家，因为开发组投入制作新的游戏而导致更新滞后的问题，我们表示深感抱歉，在进行了大半年的人事重组和整合后，我们才逐渐的恢复元气，在此我们做出表示：开发组的所有游戏都会永久更新，如对游戏内所遇到的BUG和疑问请留言或直接询问相关开发人员，希望大家能给我们足够的时间来学习和成长，感谢你们一如既往的支持和谅解。

notes.title: 《Card of spirits》v1.05 update
notes.content:
Dear Players：
《Card of spirits》- Ver1.05 update (8/8/2016), This is the first time we adjusted the game balance, yes now the game is more balanced, and this will lead you to more wins, but you still need your luck and thinks (and BUGs ? :-D).

In the older versions having a lot of wins in a row was pretty difficult, also challenging, but it's the main core of the game, but it seems like it's too hard, even with the new 8 and Z, so we made this new card, X.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25412694/bc5fcec8e0c2ef93c76b853431037c9af26e0a0f.png[/img]Special card

Singh Miraklos, and his friends John Tucke and Chekhov. Singh is Leo Miraklos'brother, after we left his brother he joined a dark organization Barbizon seven, and he become a show warrior.

X: Copy the last card used in this game (can't copy itself and Z).

Other changes:
· Total cards changed: 38 to 40, 1 changed: 4 to 3 copies, and the new X have 3 copies.
· Both players deck changed: 7 to 8.
· Fixed a bug, it happen when you copy K with Z.
· Players'Turn and Opponen's Turn message become faster.

That's it, maybe players will think that this lowered the game difficulty, but this is not true, mastering the X will lead you to the victory!

notes.title: 《Card of spirits》v1.03 Update
notes.content:
Dear Players：

《Card of spirits》has updated to Ver1.03 (20/7/2016), this update has some major changes:

1. Five languages are available now, including  Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian and German. (Thanks to Google translator :-D).

2. Futhurmore, this new version also adds the cards’ skin features. From now on, players can play with Gabe Newell on your side lol.

3. A lot of player have complained that the game speed is a little slow (Actually, you can speed up with Spacebar). Now the game speed is more comfortable.

4. We cannot help talking about the biggest change, two new cards are added, in this new version -- “8” and “Z”!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25412694/6f232926976083cd3146a539910c2c3ad039c728.png[/img]Common card

In the last version the number “7” was the biggest and strongest,  just like its artwork: the warlord of the grassland. Now his brother, “8”, has finally decided to make the change in order to punish his brother.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25412694/a17e537ea83d3beee0f7525e58457dc841e322f9.png[/img]Special card

Besides JQK, Z appeared as a new identity. Monkey King， the hero of Chinese mythology， can use any effect of other special cards randomly!

5. The deck is adjusted at: 38 total cards (Random allocation), 1 to 5 have each 4 copy, 6 have 3 copy, 7 have 2 copy, 8 have only 1 copy, and then there is JQKZ, they have 3 copy each.
Also the deck from both players have 2 more cards, (5 → 7).

We hope this update can satisfy your curiosity and we can’t wait to see what you think of our shiny new features.
